risks.note: Named by management in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' as one of the risks common to the industry. The business depends on product registrations and approvals — 24 new registration applications were submitted during the year with 19 registrations expected next year, and the Pregabalin Gel launch required CDSCO approval — so approval timing directly gates new-product revenue.

Named by management in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns'. The Board's report confirms it bit during the year: certain markets experienced foreign exchange fluctuations (alongside political uncertainty) because of which purchases were delayed.
Explicitly listed by management in MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' among the risks common to the industry.

The Board's report states the export business did not meet expectations because international Government tenders had exhausted their budgets — a structural dependence on government tender cycles and their budget availability, outside the Company's control.
risks.risk: Export demand concentrated in international Government tenders

risks.note: The Board's report attributes delayed purchases in certain markets to political uncertainty; the MD&A macro commentary additionally flags continued geopolitical tensions, higher energy prices, trade protectionism and debt vulnerabilities in emerging economies.
risks.risk: Geopolitical and political uncertainty in export markets

risks.note: The operating loss for the year is stated to arise primarily from a one-time impairment charge related to the Company's investment in, and outstanding loans given to, its subsidiary Lyka BDR International Limited, presented as an exceptional item — evidencing that the Company carries material credit and investment exposure to that entity.
risks.risk: Exposure to the subsidiary Lyka BDR International Limited

risks.note: The Company states it is engaged in only one segment, viz. pharmaceuticals, so there is no diversification outside the pharmaceutical cycle; growth depends on the human and veterinary healthcare businesses and on the new FertiNova (ART/IVF) division rather than on unrelated earnings streams.

Management explains the year-on-year movement in its key ratios by pointing to increased borrowings — the current ratio fell because of the increase in borrowings for the year, and the debt-equity ratio rose because of new loans availed during the financial year — while interest cover turned negative on negative EBIT.
